1935, September
FR. SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 37 Sep. 10 Vernis Sprague - 21 - fits for 14 yrs. Sometimes very sick - doctored all over - nothing seems to help - proposes To-day if helped will en- roll as perpetual -
Nellie Welsh .. . girls' home
12 Anna Sullivan - Lenox, Mich. - middle - kidney trouble
Marvin Jos. Czrniak - 5 - dumb - can hear - seems bright boy but fidg- ity & estremely nerveous. Enrolled (50c) folks promise frequent com- munion.
13 Mrs. Blanche Masse from Receiving Hosp (% Dr. King) - 45 - has 3 chil- dren & Husband. She fell when 10 yrs. old injuring her spine. Now fears insanity. Questioned about receiving the sacraments ... "I go every couple of months". Husband has not made Easter for 12 yrs.
Page 38 Sep. 13 Henry Siebert - 38 - speechless since yesterday ... away from confession for many years. Had accident last July last - speechless for time - Now enrolled in Ser. Mass A. and promises to go to confession as soon as possible - will go to-morrow ... Sept. 14 Thank God speech OK. Was to confession this p.m. P.S. Nov. Ist a.m.
14 Baby Robert Granger - presbiterian - 7 mo. - Sarcomic (blood-cancer) given 3 - 4 months to live. Enrolled This P.M. - 50c
14 Emily Marie Pouliot - 62 - internal cancer. Has five children all set- tled in "life" own house, but neglecting religion. Youngest pleaded for prayers. Enrolls Mother, weeping
Michael Dwyer - 93 - facial cancer - Mercy Hall. Joan Molloy - 12 - . .. Defective.
Page 39 Sep. 16 Mrs. Geroy - 58 - fears operation on forehead ..... wart or ..... Lloyd Walker - 17 - chemical-accident- it was feared that he would be blind but now there is good hope ...
17
E'd Kamire - 45 - lutheran - T.B. feared
Andrew Keller - 42 - over 20 yrs. away from confession; now Extremely nerveous - like palsey ...
